name: The Wayward Warrior
summary: Krom'rosh asks you to join his brother Dag'rosh at the Twilight's Hammer stronghold west of Rog'mar. The cult's foothold in Sunnyglade has weakened, and the fight is moving to its stronghold.

sections.title: A Brother Ahead
sections.body: Krom'rosh sends you after Dag'rosh, who has gone ahead with a scouting party. The hills west of Rog'mar are where you are to find him. Krom'rosh says the Twilight's Hammer has lost ground in Sunnyglade, and their ogre warriors have turned against them. Now he wants you beside his brother as the battle moves to the cult's stronghold.

faq.q: Who is asking me to find Dag'rosh?
faq.answer: Krom'rosh asks you to join his brother Dag'rosh at the Twilight's Hammer stronghold.
Krom'rosh says to look for Dag'rosh in the hills west of Rog'mar.
Dag'rosh is Krom'rosh's brother. He has gone ahead with a scouting party.

faq.q: What happened to the Twilight's Hammer in Sunnyglade?
faq.answer: The Twilight's Hammer foothold in Sunnyglade has weakened, and its ogre warriors have turned against it.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Wayward Warrior
